description: Source code for an Android app's SmsManager class, providing functionalities to send and search SMS messages with permission handling and contact integration.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: Handles sending and searching SMS messages, managing permissions, and interacting with Android's SMS and contact providers.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has SEND_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_CONTACTS permission.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can send SMS based on permissions and device capabilities.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can search SMS based on permissions.

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Checks if the app can read SMS (alias for canSearchSms).

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Checks if device has telephony feature.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester to handle permission prompts.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SMS message based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Asynchronously searches SMS messages based on provided query parameters in JSON.

methods.name: ensureSmsPermission
methods.description: Ensures SEND_SMS permission is granted, requesting if necessary.

methods.name: ensureReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Ensures READ_SMS permission is granted, requesting if necessary.

methods.name: ensureReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Ensures READ_CONTACTS permission is granted, requesting if necessary.

methods.name: okResult
methods.description: Constructs a successful SendResult object.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs a failed SendResult object with error details.

methods.name: queryOk
methods.description: Constructs a successful SearchResult with message list and metadata.

methods.name: queryError
methods.description: Constructs a failed SearchResult with an error message.

methods.name: getPhoneNumbersFromContactName
methods.description: Retrieves contact phone numbers matching the specified contact name.

methods.name: querySmsMessages
methods.description: Queries SMS messages based on query parameters and contact numbers.

methods.name: querySmsMmsMessagesByPhone
methods.description: Retrieves SMS/MMS messages associated with a specific phone number.

methods.name: getMmsTextBody
methods.description: Fetches MMS text body for a given message ID.

methods.name: getMmsMeta
methods.description: Retrieves message box and read status metadata for MMS.

methods.name: getMmsAddress
methods.description: Gets the address for an MMS message, optionally selecting preferred address.
